name: My crazy love story
source:
You have a pretty normal life; some would even call it boring. You have friends; you go to the university. Nothing out of the ordinary. But everything will change when you encounter dangerous men who take an interest in you.

How will this story end for you?

[From [url=https://malouinc.itch.io/my-crazy-love-story]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你的生活很正常；有些人甚至会说这很无聊。你有朋友；你去大学。没什么不寻常的。但当你遇到对你感兴趣的危险男人时，一切都会改变。

这个故事对你来说将如何结束？

[来自[url=https://malouinc.itch.io/my-crazy-love-story]Itch.io[/url]]
